GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2023-01-03T18:58:10Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: String values in Parquet files
Description: Somewhat related to #43970, I've noticed ClickHouse doesn't mark string fields as Strings when exporting to Parquet. BigQuery will treat the fields as binary (unless overridden) as will QGIS when opening PQ files generated by ClickHouse.

```bash
$ cat California.jsonl \
    | clickhouse local \
          --input-format JSONEachRow \
          -q "SELECT *
              FROM table
              FORMAT Parquet" \
    > cali.snappy.pq
```

```python
In [1]: import pyarrow.parquet as pq

In [2]: pf = pq.ParquetFile('cali.snappy.pq')

In [3]: pf.schema
Out[3]: 
<pyarrow._parquet.ParquetSchema object at 0x105ccc940>
required group field_id=-1 schema {
  optional int64 field_id=-1 release;
  optional binary field_id=-1 capture_dates_range;
  optional binary field_id=-1 geom;
}
```

Most other tools, including the Rust release of Arrow will mark these fileds as strings.

```bash
$ json2parquet \
      -c snappy \
      California.jsonl \
      California.snappy.pq
```

```python
In [1]: import pyarrow.parquet as pq

In [2]: pf = pq.ParquetFile('California.snappy.pq')

In [3]: pf.schema
Out[3]: 
<pyarrow._parquet.ParquetSchema object at 0x109a11380>
required group field_id=-1 arrow_schema {
  optional binary field_id=-1 capture_dates_range (String);
  optional binary field_id=-1 geom (String);
  optional int64 field_id=-1 release;
}
```
